dapat: there is or can be found
serah: up to you, as you wish
rawat: to be treated or cared for
injak: to set or put foot on
tanggap: to respond to or comment on
pamer: to be exhibited or shown off
jabat: to hold office or shake hands
gendong: to carry on back or hip
